tree.heading: Agreement for Study
tree.text: The Secretary shall offer to enter into an agreement with the National Research Council under which the National Research Council shall—

children.text: conduct a study of the progress made under the methane hydrate research and development program implemented under this chapter; and
make recommendations for future methane hydrate research and development needs.

tree.heading: Report
tree.text: Not later than September 30, 2009, the Secretary shall submit to Congress a report containing the findings and recommendations of the National Research Council under this section.

notes.text: Prior ProvisionsA prior section 5 of Pub. L. 106–193 was set out in a note under section 1902 of this title prior to the general amendment of Pub. L. 106–193 by Pub. L. 109–58.
